name: PILOT (E3MolDiffusion)
what_it_is: An equivariant diffusion model for pocket-conditioned de novo 3D ligand generation, combining continuous and discrete denoising with multi-objective importance sampling for binding affinity and synthetic accessibility guidance.
constraints: Model weights not bundled; request by email
SLURM HPC assumed; no single-machine orchestration
Pocket requires reference ligand; no blind docking
V100 GPU assumed for batch sizing
